property_summary: For any caller whose recorded deposit balance is at least the requested `_am` (and >= MinSum, with the unlock time passed), Collect(_am) must leave balance reduced by exactly `_am`; the mutant's strict `> _am` guard refuses the exact-balance case, so balance stays unchanged instead of decreasing by `_am`.
change_summary: Changed the Collect balance guard from >= _am to > _am, so a zero-value or exact-balance collect call diverges in whether it completes.
